definitions.explanation: A performer's very first appearance on stage, or more broadly, someone's first time doing something in a public or prominent setting.

examples.japanese: {五歳|ごさい}で{初舞台|はつぶたい}を{踏|ふ}んだ。
examples.english: She made her stage debut at age five.

examples.japanese: {初舞台|はつぶたい}は{緊張|きんちょう}で{足|あし}が{震|ふる}えた。
examples.english: On my first stage appearance, my legs were shaking with nervousness.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{初舞台|はつぶたい}にもかかわらず{堂々|どうどう}とした{演技|えんぎ}を{見|み}せて、{観客|かんきゃく}を{魅了|みりょう}した。
examples.english: Despite it being his debut, he gave a commanding performance that captivated the audience.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common expression is {初舞台|はつぶたい}を{踏|ふ}む (literally, to step on one's first stage). This is the standard way to say "to make one's debut performance." Can also be used figuratively for any first-time public appearance or first attempt in a new arena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}を{踏|ふ}む (to make one's stage debut)
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}を{飾|かざ}る (to mark one's debut)
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}の{思|おも}い{出|で} (memories of one's debut)

RELATED WORDS:
- デビュー: debut (loanword)
- {舞台|ぶたい}: stage
- {初|はつ}{出演|しゅつえん}: first appearance (in a show)
- {初|はつ}{登場|とうじょう}: first appearance
